title: Stripline of two lossy plies (core and prepreg, both εr = 4.4, tan δ = 0.02): a 1.5 mm strip across the middle of a 6 × 3 mm box, 6 mm long, its ports across both materials
source: Two conductors in one homogeneous lossy dielectric carry a TEM wave with γ = jk0 √(εr(1 − j tan δ)), Re γ ≥ 0, whatever the cross-section (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §§2.7, 3.7; time dependence e^{jωt}): α = Re γ, −Re γ²/k0² = εr, S21 = e^{−γL}, S11 = 0; evaluated separately from EMCraft's code

quantities.quantity: attenuation of the first port mode at 10 GHz (dB/mm), 20 log e · α
quantities.reason: the port's two materials take the hybrid lossy solver; one dielectric in effect, so its TEM mode is exact in the cross-section's elements but for rounding (measured 4e-12)

quantities.quantity: −Re γ²/k0² of the first port mode at 10 GHz
quantities.reason: exact but for rounding, as the attenuation (measured 2e-12)
the volume's 1.5 mm cells graded at the strip's edges, order 2, as the lossless `stripline` case: +2e-6 dB here, +7e-5 dB at 10 GHz (|S11| about 1e-4)
the phase error of second-order elements over 0.4 wavelengths in the dielectric (the lossless `stripline` case: 0.003° in PTFE; here, in εr = 4.4: +0.005°)
the ports' hybrid lossy modes in the volume's trace space: discretisation error only
